svg.title: How ResumeCraft works: fill in three steps, watch the live resume and completion ring, export to DOCX
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough. A form is filled in for personal details, education and skills while an A4 resume builds itself and a completion ring climbs 33, 66, 100 percent, then a DOCX is exported.
